text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While wandering around town, Inari One
and Twin
Turbo spot a notice posted on
a run-down
bathhouse storefront and
stop to read it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Scheduled for permanent closure due
to decline
in business..." Whoa, it sounds
like they're in big
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We can't let that happen! C'mon, Turbo!
We've
gotta save this bathhouse!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We'll pull 'em out of the water,
just like
fishing!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heya Trainer! We just found out my
favorite
bathhouse is in some serious
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So Turbo and I are thinkin' about makin'
and
postin' an ad for it online to attract
customers!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh! Turbo BRAIN BLAST! I just got
the best
idea for an ad!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We can say the sauna's as hot as the
Earth's core!
Something that special is
bound to get a line
going right out the
door!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I like that! And we can say the
bath after
the sauna's as cold as a
glacier!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their ideas run about as wildly as they
do on the
track... and there's no one
around to stop them.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Keep those ideas comin', Turbo! This
ad's gonna
be the best!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You got it! Turbo BOOOOOST!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And after much hard work, they finally
finish their
ad.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! I'm so tired all the time! What should I do, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's only one place to go if your
body's in
need of a full recharge!

text_block_list.name: Inari and Turbo
text_block_list.text: And that's the bathhouse!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
After rinsing yourself off with some nice
hot
water, hop in the sauna for a Turbo
Charge! ☆

text_block_list.name: Inari and Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This feels real nice... Like my soul might
just up
and fly away outta sheer bliss...

text_block_list.name: Inari and Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And the best thing to drink after a long
soak in
the bath? That's gotta be
Vita-Uma Orange Juice!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If your cap says "WINNER," you can get
ten more
bottles for free!

text_block_list.name: Inari and Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Come visit us soon! Can't wait to see you
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ad is chaos. Pure chaos. Still, it's

unexpectedly well-made.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Howzat for an ad, eh? Didja see the shot
of us in
the sauna? We looked like the
picture of
relaxation!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It took a bit of trial and error, but the
more I
pushed Turbo, the better her
actin' got!
choice_data_list: あんな顔、どうやって撮ったんだ？
あんな顔、どうやって撮ったの？
choice_data_list_en: How did you manage to get a shot of that face?
How did you manage to catch that expression on camera?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I got us both in the sauna, challenged
her to an
endurance test, and ta-da! The
shot came out
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Turbo. She has a habit of makin' videos
in our
room when she's feelin' down and
antsy.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I never feel down! I just sometimes
feel like
I'm a big dummy, so I play on
the computer for a
bit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
How's that different from feelin' down?
Well,
whatever. Anyway!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When you needa job well done, ya leave
it to the
experts, I say!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought these two were just flying by
the seat of
their pants, but it turns out I
was wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when she's charging straight ahead,
Inari
One still makes sure to get a good
grasp of the
people around her and their
strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when she's charging straight ahead,
Inari
One still makes sure to get a good
grasp of the
people around her and their
strengths.
choice_data_list: プロの仕事みたいだった
choice_data_list_en: You've got a good eye for people.
You've got a good eye for people.
That looked like the work of a professional.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aw, this is nothin'. Turbo and I are
roommates, so
of course I knew about
her talent.
choice_data_list: プロの仕事みたいだった
choice_data_list_en: You've got a good eye for people.
You've got a good eye for people.
That looked like the work of a professional.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, workin' together's the best way
to get
stuff done. Whether you're
buildin' a house or a
castle...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ya can't do it alone.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No way the bathhouse'll close down
now! Come
on, Turbo, let's have a soak!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We'll be able to come here
whenever we
want now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as they drop their chaotic ad, it
goes
viral, and the bathhouse in town is
saved from
closure.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it? Well, I was just kinda
draggin' Turbo
along with my antics,
buuut...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You did a bangin' job, Turbo! The ad's
perfect,
thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! I did pretty great, didn't I? You
can
count on me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One makes sure to give proper
credit to her
friend and boosts her up.
She may be impulsive,
but she's a good
and fair leader indeed.
